plan.notes: Source: 'Sample Degree Plan: Bachelor of Science (BS) Chemistry', Bulletin Year 2022-2023 (shc.edu Program Checklists page). Sample plan; the Degree Audit in BadgerWeb is the official degree plan per the plan's own footer. Genuine catalog quirks kept verbatim: semester 2 prints 'PTh100I' (capital T); CHM442's prerequisite prints 'MTH323' while the sequenced calculus course is MTH223 Calculus III; semester 7's Visual/Performing Arts row is 4 credits (unusual, kept); the semester 7 CHM461 row prints garbled prerequisite text ('BIO360 Cell Biology is recommended-prerequisites BIO205/BIO207-prerequisite CHM112 or BIO241 prerequisite BIO101 and CHM232)') - recorded verbatim in choice_note. Sequenced sum 121 matches the printed 'Total Semester Hours: 121'.
